{"metadata":{"description":"dsh-custom-plugin是一个为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 打造的增强插件。提供：背景天气特效/玻璃拟态、时间线轨道、项目文件夹、提示词库、对话导出、Mermaid 图表渲染、引用回复、余额查询与每日 Token 用量面板等多种便利功能","id":"gh:1342948215","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-custom-plugin","slug":"AlexPeng07/dsh-custom-plugin","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"dsh-custom-plugin是一个为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 打造的增强插件。提供：背景天气特效/玻璃拟态、时间线轨道、项目文件夹、提示词库、对话导出、Mermaid 图表"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"渲染、引用回复、余额查询与每日 Token 用量面板等多种便利功能"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-custom-plugin"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Custom convenience suite for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: personalization, weather FX, glass "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"effects, project folders, enhanced prompts, conversation export/search, Mermaid rendering, quote rep"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ly, 7/30/90-day usage analytics, budget and key-free local backups, plus a Ctrl/Cmd+K command palett"},{"id":"p4s4","text":", 7/30/90-day usage analytics, budget and key-free local backups, plus a Ctrl/Cmd+K command palette."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The plugin is dual-face: the host half (`src/`) owns the state document, registers the `/api/custom-"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"plugin` routes and the `custom_plugin_status` agent tool; the browser half (`src/client/`) injects i"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ts UI through eight injections into seven official slots and talks to the host over same-origin fetc"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"h. Mounted through the official profile mechanism — no DSH source changes."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Selected screenshots"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Settings → 个性化: the full-page appearance config"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The same panel as a popover from the session header (light theme)"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Liquid glass (displacement refraction on Custom surfaces)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Multi-level project folders"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Mermaid mindmap rendered in place"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Balance and today's per-model usage"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Rain (three depth layers)"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Sakura"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Snow"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Weather FX is shown in dark mode. Usage history, backup-import previews, session search, and the com"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"mand palette are dynamic views of the same panel; open them inside DSH to inspect the live UI — no a"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"dditional fixed screenshots are included."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Appearance"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Background colors**: 20 muted low-saturation palettes (each with a matching tab color, `天青灰` by "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"default) plus "no color" (follows the GUI default theme). Every palette works in both themes; dark m"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ode derives the same family's dark variant (hue and low saturation kept, lightness dropped onto the "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"dark ramp), and the swatch preview shows what the current theme will actually paint.
- **Weather FX*"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"*: canvas-rendered, pointer-transparent one-click overlays — falling snow, cinematic rain (three dep"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"th layers with splashes), and drifting sakura petals; turning it off clears the canvas.
- **Glass**:"},{"id":"p19s7","text":" frosted glass on every Custom surface, or liquid glass (edge displacement refraction chained with a"},{"id":"p19s8","text":" slight blur + saturation so text over large panels stays readable; engines without SVG-referencing "},{"id":"p19s9","text":"backdrop filters fall back to frosted). A global-glass option extends the same treatment to dialogs,"},{"id":"p19s10","text":" menus, tooltips, listboxes and the system settings window — displaced as well in liquid mode."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Project folders"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"A multi-level folder tree persisted in the `$DSH_HOME` state file, shared across workspaces. Any wor"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"kspace or session can be folded in; folders support drag-to-reorder (before / inside / after), renam"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"e, delete, and add-current-session shortcuts."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Prompts"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"A prompt library with add / edit / copy / delete, search, favorites, tags, drag sorting, recency and"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" use counts. `{{variable}}` placeholders open a fill-in form before insertion. The library supports "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"versioned JSON and heading-based Markdown import/export."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Conversation export"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Export the current session in three formats (file names carry a date stamp):"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **JSON**: standard `messages` structure (user / assistant / tool), with a meta block carrying the "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"session title, creation time, working directory and export time — importable elsewhere;
- **Markdown"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"**: role-sectioned plain text;
- **PDF**: an A4 print-layout HTML opened in the browser and saved as"},{"id":"p26s4","text":" PDF; images embed as base64 (up to 30 images, 12 MB total, 4 MB each)."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Tool rows carry the tool name and an argument digest (resolved from the paired tool/call events)."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Plugin state can be exported as a versioned JSON backup containing appearance, folders, prompts, sta"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"rs, usage, and budget settings. API keys and credential metadata are excluded. Imports show a confli"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ct preview, support merge or non-secret replacement, and create a recovery copy first."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Mermaid"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]
sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @alexpeng/dsh-custom-plugin
# restart dsh web"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]
sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:AlexPeng07/dsh-custom-plugin
# restart dsh web"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]
sh
# build (run from this repo root)
pnpm install
pnpm build
# add to the web profile. "},{"id":"p32s2","text":"The link path must not contain spaces: on Windows,
# create a space-free directory junction first an"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"d link to the junction path
dsh plugin --profile web add link:F:/dsh-plugin-dev
# restart dsh web"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]
sh
pnpm typecheck      # type check

pnpm build "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"         # build the node ESM library and the browser bundle into lib/
pnpm check:readme   # bilingu"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"al README hash consistency
pnpm smoke          # post-build contract checks: loader handshake, manif"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"est
# fields dsh reads, patch row, local Mermaid engine,

DSH_HOME=/tmp/dshnext-home DSH_PORT=13999 COOKIE_JAR=/tmp/dshnext/j"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"ar.txt bash scripts/live-dsh-check.sh"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]
